findings.evidence: def search_tickets(filters: dict[str, str], order: str = "newest", limit: int = 50) -> list[tuple]:
findings.recommendation: The new operation takes no caller identity and applies no restriction of its own: any console user who can call it lists every ticket, any assignee's included (`assignee` is a free filter, not the caller). If tickets are not meant to be visible to every agent, take the caller as a parameter and scope the query server-side (CWE-862). Confidence is low because no caller of `search_tickets` is in the change, so whether the console already restricts who reaches it could not be checked. The query itself is safe: column fragments and sort orders come only from the `FILTERS` and `ORDERS` allow-lists, and values and the limit are bound parameters.
findings.title: Search returns every ticket with no caller scope
